blocks.prompt: 9. A machine is purchased for Rs.20,000. Depreciates at 6% per annum for the first four years and after that 8% per annum for the next six years. Depreciation being calculated on diminishing value. Find the value of the machine after a period of 10 years.
blocks.explanation:
Depreciation ka matlab machine ki qeemat ka har saal kam hona. "On diminishing value" ka matlab hai ke har saal ka nuqsaan ghatti hui (mojooda) qeemat ka percentage hai, asal 20000 ka nahi. Is liye har saal qeemat ek hi number se multiply hoti hai, yani G.P., lekin 4 saal baad ratio badal jata hai.
Plan: pehle 4 saal 0.94 se, phir agle 6 saal 0.92 se multiply karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: Qeemat Rs. 20000; 4 saal 6% depreciation, phir 6 saal 8%, diminishing value par.
Humein find karna hai: 10 saal baad machine ki qeemat.
Tareeqa: Pehle 4 saal G.P. \(r = 0.94\), phir agle 6 saal nayi G.P. \(r = 0.92\).

Saalana multipliers nikalein
\[1 - 0.06 = 0.94\]
\[1 - 0.08 = 0.92\]
Kyun: Agar 6% kam ho to 94% bachta hai, yani 0.94 guna. Isi tarah 8% kam ho to 0.92 guna. Ghatne wali G.P. mein \(r = 1 - \frac{\text{rate}}{100}\) hota hai.

4 saal baad qeemat
\[(0.94)^2 = 0.8836\]
\[(0.94)^4 = 0.78074896\]
\[V_4 = 20000(0.94)^4\]
\[\approx 15614.98\]
Kyun: 4 saal mein 4 dafa 0.94 se multiply. 0.94 ka square, phir us ka square: \((0.94)^4\). 20000 se multiply kar ke taqreeban 15614.98.

Agle 6 saal baad qeemat
\[(0.92)^3 = 0.778688\]
\[(0.92)^6 \approx 0.60635500\]
\[V_{10} = V_4 (0.92)^6\]
\[\approx 9468.22\]
Kyun: Ab nayi rate se 6 saal: \(V_4\) ko 6 dafa 0.92 se multiply. \((0.92)^3\) nikal kar square kiya to \((0.92)^6\). Ek line mein: \(V_{10} = 20000(0.94)^4(0.92)^6 \approx 9468.22\).
Dhyan dein: har saal 20000 ka 6% (Rs. 1200) ghatana ghalat hai; woh diminishing value nahi, original value par depreciation hoti (A.P. ban jaati).

Tasdeeq
\[V_{10} < V_4 < 20000\]
Kyun: Qeemat har saal kam hoti gayi aur 10 saal baad aadhi se thodi kam reh gayi; 10 saal mein kul taqreeban 53% kami 6% aur 8% ki rates ke hisaab se maqool hai.
